item.title: BHTwitter v4.4
item.description:
BHTwitter 4.4 | BHTwitter-sideloaded
Update BHTwitter 4.4: - Fix all the crashes in the newer versions. - Add the new tabs to the hide page. - New feature: DM replay later page and tags. - New feature: Upload 4K media. - New feature: Voice feature in posts and replies. - Update the localizations. - Remove unnecessary options.
Thanks for: - @actuallyaridan - @Tulugaak
